Short-term Exchange Program JUSST
Application
Application for JUSST Program
Eligible Applicants
Student Status Conditions
You may apply if you are currently a regular undergraduate or graduate student
in the field of Science or Engineering
at one of the UEC Partner Universities. An applicant must be a
3rd or 4th year
undergraduate
, or a
graduate
student at the time of enrollment in the JUSST Program.
Students who are in their final year
may apply for this program
only if
their home university certifies that the applicant will continue to be enrolled at the home university after completing the UEC Exchange Study Program (e.g., by extending the applicant's graduation date until the Exchange Program is finished).
*Participants are not allowed to leave the program during their enrollment term under any circumstances
(
except for emergencies
). Please consider this commitment when applying for the program.
Academic Requirement and Selection Criteria
Academic Background:
Applicants should have a good grounding in the field of Informatics, Science, or Engineering.
Academic Record:
Applicants must have a good academic record, meeting one of the following minimum average scores:
80% or higher
2.3 or higher (on a 3.0 GPA Scale)
3.0 or higher (on a 4.0 GPA Scale)
5.5 or higher (on a 7.0 GPA Scale)
Language Requirement
English Language Proficiency:
Proficiency in English is required. Applicants must
provide equivalent test
scores, such as:
TOEFL iBT:
67 or higher
CEFR:
B2 or higher
IELTS:
6.0 or higher
Duolingo:
95 or higher
Japanese Language Proficiency:
Japanese language proficiency
is not required
.
Character Requirement
Applicants are expected to demonstrate the following character traits:
Health and Attitude:
Must be physically and mentally fit, with a
positive attitude
toward studies and compliance with rules and regulations.
Adaptability:
Must be adaptable to new circumstances and challenges.
Interpersonal Skills:
Must be
self-motivated
and able to
cooperate effectively
in cross-cultural, interdisciplinary environments.
Sociability:
Should be sociable, friendly, interested in making friends with students from different nationalities, humorous, etc.
